title: Rawang language
extract: Rawang (Rvwàng) is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken primarily in northern Myanmar and northeast India. While Rawang displays a high degree of internal diversity—with some varieties being mutually intelligible only with difficulty—the Mutwang (Matwang) dialect is widely accepted as the standard for communication and the basis of the written language.
